entities.summary: Natan Slifkin, popularly known as the "Zoo Rabbi", is an Israeli Modern Orthodox rabbi, and the director of the Biblical Museum of Natural History in Beit Shemesh, Israel. Slifkin is best known for his interests in zoology, Judaism's relationship to evolution, Jewish and biblical history, and his writing on these topics.
